connector.name: Platfone
connector.registryDescription: Virtual phone numbers for AI agents - rent numbers in 200+ countries, receive SMS.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.platfone.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the platfone-com account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
